content: {"like": ["The \"Diary of Anne Frankenstein\" was the best part, with its mix of truly bad taste and Hogan's Hero-esque humor.", "The 1960s film look in the initial \"Wadzilla\" feature was well done, even better than the story itself.", "The cast performed well, despite not being the writers or directors."], "dislike": ["The film was over‑the‑top horror‑comedy that relied on 3‑year‑old toilet humor.", "It was too long, with jokes going stale after about 15 minutes.", "The campiness was unsubtle and in‑your‑face, quickly losing its shock value.", "The humor devolved into obnoxiousness and failed to be genuinely comedic.", "There was no real attempt to make an actual horror movie, making it a miserably failed comedy."]}
